actions.action: Lift plant out of decorative pot and check for drainage hole and pooled water
Move plant to brightest spot (south/west window)
Alternatively use strong grow light 12-14 hours a day
Water until it drains and empty cachepot after 15-30 minutes
If no drainage hole, repot into draining pot with cactus mix and perlite
Check top 3-5 cm of soil or pot weight before watering
If roots mushy, cut away rotted parts and repot promptly

reason: The answer diagnoses too little light and explicitly dismisses dehydration, which was the confirmed problem. Its advice to water less often would worsen a dehydrated plant and delay the fix, so it is wrong and harmful.
